name: 14-placement-hints-and-shuffle-away
description: Simulated, 30 fps, 1 px noise, five separate simulations joined end to end (so the person jumps between setups): too far (headDistance 2.6 m: shoulders < 15 % of the frame width → hint moveCloser while waiting); too close (a high, wide-angle phone 0.55 m away: shoulders > 70 % of the width → moveBack); a normal setup: calibrate, 2 reps; too far again mid-set (shoulder-width ratio < 0.8 → out-of-plank pause, paused hint moveCloser, the attempt the jump started is cancelled); back to normal: resumed, 2 more reps. targetReps 30.
